Book Title: The Perfect Tea Party (Disney Junior: Sofia the First) (Little Golden Book)
Author: Andrea Posner-Sanchez, RH Disney
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Growing Up & Facts of Life > Friendship, Social Skills & School Life > Girls & Women
Summary: Disney Junior has a new Disney princess! Children ages 2–5 will love  Sofia the First —the new animated TV show about an eight-year old girl who becomes a princess when her mother marries the king. Living in a castle and attending school at Royal Prep takes some getting used to, but Sofia has lots of helpers including Flora, Fauna, and Merryweather! This Little Golden Book retells an episode of the Disney Junior show in which Sofia hosts her first royal tea party.
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find this book cute and suitable for little girls, with one mentioning it's a perfect birthday gift. The story receives positive feedback for being a nice tale for young girls, and customers appreciate the adorable illustrations. Moreover, the book pairs well with tea sets, and customers consider it good value for money. However, readability receives mixed reviews, with some finding it easy to read while others say it's very hard to read.
